notes: Deploy ledger fully before customer. This is an additive, backward-compatible change: ledger keeps the legacy amount column and payment.posted amount event field, writes both representations, and reads rows written by old or new instances. The old customer remains compatible with the new ledger; the new customer may require ledger.balanceCents. No queue drain or atomic switch is required. Rollback is safe because the new column is nullable and old instances ignore it.
